titleEn: Windows Replacement in Vancouver: A Homeowner's Guide 2026
titleZh: 温哥华窗户更换完整指南 2026
contentEn:
Vancouver's rain, humidity, and temperature swings make window replacement one of the highest-ROI renovations a homeowner can do. A proper window upgrade cuts heating drafts, reduces condensation mould risk, lowers energy bills, and recovers 70–80% of its cost at resale. This guide covers real Vancouver 2026 pricing, BC Building Code requirements, and how Reno Stars handles the full installation.

How Much Does Window Replacement Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Window replacement in Vancouver costs $800–$2,500 per window installed, depending on frame material, size, and glazing performance. For a typical Vancouver single-family home with 15–20 windows, the total investment ranges from $15,000 to $45,000. Vinyl windows sit at the budget end ($800–$1,200 per window), while fibreglass and wood-clad options run $1,200–$2,500 per window. Labour in Metro Vancouver adds $150–$300 per window for removal and installation.

In most cases, window replacement in Vancouver does not require a building permit — only a sign-off from the窗户更换不一定需要许可证，具体视更换窗户的数量和尺寸而定。如果涉及结构改造，比如扩大开口，就需要申请许可证。Reno Stars 负责办理所有必需的许可证文件。

What Windows Work Best for Vancouver's Climate?

Vancouver's climate zone requires windows rated for the Pacific Northwest: at minimum, CSA A440 performance Grade 15. For north-facing walls or street-level noise (near arterials, Skytrain lines), consider acoustic-rated windows (STC 35+) with triple glazing. Avoid aluminium frames without thermal break — they conduct cold directly and cause interior condensation.

Energy Savings from Window Replacement

Energy modelling for a typical 1,800 sq ft Vancouver single-family home with R-2 single-pane windows replaced by R-5 triple-glaze vinyl shows:

  • Heating energy reduction: 20–35% annually
  • Draft elimination: eliminates cold spots near windows
  • Condensation reduction: lower interior surface temperature stops condensation on glass
  • UV fade protection: low-E coating reduces furniture and flooring fading

How Long Does Window Replacement Take?

A full-house window replacement for a single-family home takes 3–7 working days for a two-person crew. Condo replacements typically take 1–3 days per unit. Reno Stars coordinates installation to minimize weather exposure — we remove and replace windows in sequences, not all at once, to keep the home weather-tight throughout the project.
